complete_examples.text: Track random irregularity Probabilistic model Vehicle/track coupled dynamics Probability density evolution method a b s t r a c t Track irregularities generally viewed as weak stationary random processes are perhaps the most important excitations to the vehicle/track coupled system.

Track random irregularities Vehicle–track coupled model Random vibration Probabilistic density distribution a b s t r a c t As the integrated reflection of track substructure deformations and the most important excitation for vehicle– track interactions, track irregularities show random nature, and generally being regarded as weak stationary random processes.
These track irregularities are typically regarded as individual weak stationary random processes, being characterized by one-sided power spectral density (PSD) functions [1], known as track spectra.
